name: Cocoa
read: Cocoa Mar 27 options (on MAR 27 futures 5184, 88 days to expiry 2027-02-12): at-the-money implied vol 44.4%, +4.0 pts vs 2026-11-10. 20-day realized vol 39.3%, so options trade at a premium of 5.0 pts. 25-delta risk reversal +7.5 (calls over puts). Over the last 9 sessions (2026-11-04 to 2026-11-16) call open interest fell 68,306 and puts fell 32,235; put/call OI 0.44 → 0.42, front futures 5556 → 5184. Delta-weighted, option holders added about +1,027 futures-equivalent lots in the last 5 sessions (net long exposure bought through options). Front ATM vol 37.6% → 43.0%. Largest Mar 27 strikes: 6000 calls (5,725 lots) and 4500 puts (3,387). Biggest 5-session builds: May 27 5500 calls +1,850; Mar 27 6000 calls +974. Biggest cut: May 27 7000 calls -218.
